user.title: Set up Alfie
user.description: Alfie is a lively face for your home. You can rename him.

abort.already_configured: Alfie is already set up. There is one Alfie per home.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Alfie is already set up. There is one Alfie per home.

init.title: Alfie
init.description: Alfie's signals, mood, behaviour and personality are set in the **Alfie** panel in the sidebar (admins only). There is nothing to set here.

set_expression.name: Set expression
set_expression.description: Make Alfie wear an expression, for a while or until set back to auto.

expression.name: Expression
expression.description: One of the 12 expressions, or auto to follow his mood.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to hold it; empty or 0 holds it until changed.

play_animation.name: Play animation
play_animation.description: Make Alfie do something once, on every display.

show_screen.name: Show screen
show_screen.description: Make every Alfie card present one of your screens for a while, then go back to what it was doing.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of a screen built in Alfie's panel.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to show it (1 to 3600, default 20).

play_story.name: Play story
play_story.description: Make Alfie play one of his stories on every display.

story.name: Story
story.description: The id of a story from the Alfie panel's Stories tab.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 0 to 100. A higher priority interrupts a story that is playing; otherwise it waits its turn.

busy.name: When busy
busy.description: auto (by priority), queue, interrupt or skip.

stop_story.name: Stop story
stop_story.description: End the story Alfie is playing and forget any waiting ones.
